flashcards.back: Learn about the principles and techniques of AI, including machine learning, deep learning, and neural networks.
Explore NLP concepts such as tokenization, part-of-speech tagging, and sentence classification.
Learn about the principles of robotics, including motion control, sensors, and actuators.
Understand the principles of CV, including image recognition, object detection, and scene understanding.
Learn about the principles of deep learning, including neural networks, backpropagation, and optimization algorithms.
